entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Artificer and planeswalker who fights Phyrexia, heals in Serra's realm, and wars alongside Mishra.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Planeswalker who rules a realm of angels and heals Urza.

entities.name: Radiant
entities.description: Archangel of Serra's realm who counsels hard rule.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Phyrexian outcast who guides Urza and is cast down by a priest.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Yawgmoth praetor who rules cruelly and despises the forest.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Father of Machines who brushes Urza's mind and drives the Grand Evolution.

entities.name: Sitrik
entities.description: Birth priest of Phyrexia.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Master wizard of Tolaria and Urza's student.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Problem student at Tolaria.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem branded by Urza.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Artificer whose blueprints helped Urza's armor.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother who wages war on Argoth.

entities.name: Fire Eye
entities.description: Viashino bey of Shiv.

entities.name: Jula
entities.description: Goblin raider of Shiv.

entities.name: Gamelen
entities.description: Citanul elder of Argoth.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Ornithopter pilot trapped in a storm over Argoth.

entities.name: Brindri
entities.description: Heroine lifted beyond herself as an angel of light and fury.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: Angel and Radiant's finest warrior lost to the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Fiko
entities.description: Student who summoned only atogs.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: Goddess of the forest who taught Urza she controls all elements.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: Goddess who makes the honoring part of the forest.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane of Yawgmoth with towers and a Grand Evolution.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Servants of Yawgmoth hunting Urza.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Followers who found their master's severed hand in the cave of Koilos.

entities.name: Citanul
entities.description: Druids of Argoth.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Island home of Urza's academy, devoured by mists in time.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Academy at Tolaria that worked with time until time ran out.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Forest isle invaded by Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Land of dragons, goblins and viashino.

entities.name: Serra's realm
entities.description: Realm of angels tainted by Phyrexian legions.

entities.name: Viashino
entities.description: Lizard people of Shiv.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: Builders of ancient wonders.

events.summary: The Phyrexians pursuing Urza send legions into Serra's realm and leave it tainted.
events.quote: the Phyrexians sent countless foul legions into Serra's realm.

events.summary: Radiant tells Serra to go and leave the world to those who truly care.
events.quote: Go, then," the angel spat at Serra

events.summary: Serra tells Urza that Xantcha is recovering and her magic would have killed her.
events.quote: Xantcha is recovering.

events.summary: Serra tells Radiant it is not her place to rule.
events.quote: It is not your place to rule, Radiant.

events.summary: Urza tells Serra he cannot fight and only wants rest.
events.quote: I do not care if I live or die, so long as I can rest.

events.summary: Serra tells the custodians to guard Urza as he heals for five years.
events.quote: Serra told them to guard Urza as he healed. Five years they stood.

events.summary: Barrin's progress report calls Teferi a problem student.
events.quote: Teferi is a problem student.

events.summary: Urza urges Barrin to be patient as a prize student cannot be replaced.
events.quote: Books can be replaced; a prize student cannot.

events.summary: Urza finds silver passes the portal undamaged and designs a silver golem.
events.quote: He immediately designed a golem made of the metal.

events.summary: Time floods and Tolaria is drowned in an instant stretching toward infinity.
events.quote: Tolaria was drowned in an instant that stretched toward infinity.

events.summary: Yawgmoth brushes Urza's mind and Urza's world convulses.
events.quote: Yawgmoth brushed Urza's mind, and Urza's world convulsed.

events.summary: Xantcha warns Urza that Phyrexians in human skin are everywhere.
events.quote: They are the sleeper agents, and they are everywhere.

events.summary: Urza thinks he is on a crusade while Xantcha knows it is a robbery.
events.quote: Urza thought it a crusade. Xantcha knew it was a robbery.

events.summary: Gix silences Xantcha.
events.quote: Do not presume to speak for yourself.

events.summary: Radiant prays that Lady Selenia died honorably after her loss to the Phyrexians.
events.quote: My finest warrior was lost to the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Urza attacks Phyrexia and Phyrexia slowly retaliates.
events.quote: Urza dared to attack Phyrexia. Slowly, it retaliated.

events.summary: Gix despises the forest, pleased only by the gouge the portal tore.
events.quote: Gix despised the sylvan morass.

events.summary: Xantcha defies Gix.
events.quote: then you'll never control me.

events.summary: A priest casts Xantcha down and calls to scrap her.
events.quote: The priest cast Xantcha to the ground.

events.summary: Urza brands Karn with a glyph affirming his role.
events.quote: By this glyph I affirm your role.

events.summary: Urza and Mishra's war leads herders to encourage stampedes.
events.quote: Before Urza and Mishra came to Argoth

events.summary: Urza smells a metallic stench and knows his brother is dead.
events.quote: It was then he knew his brother was no more.

events.summary: Mishra orders cutting trees from beneath the enemy.
events.quote: Force them to fight on our terms.

events.summary: Urza tries to rule the air but Gaea teaches him otherwise.
events.quote: Gaea taught him that she controlled all the elements.

events.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix find their master's severed hand in Koilos.
events.quote: they found their master's severed hand.

events.summary: Mishra's helix reflects his strategy that if he couldn't have Argoth no one could.
events.quote: if he couldn't have Argoth, no one could.

events.summary: Urza realizes the Phyrexians would still resist him if torn to pieces.
events.quote: Urza saw the wall and realized

events.summary: Urza says he sealed himself in a walking crypt of armor.
events.quote: I sealed myself in a walking crypt.

relations.note: Radiant is archangel of Serra's realm.
Fire Eye is a viashino bey.
